rationale.automation-bias: Synthesizes over-trust, complacency, skill erosion, and missed contradictory evidence.
rationale.risk-routing: Routes task automation levels by complexity, criticality, and error cost.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Requires analyst approval or veto before consequential automated actions execute.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Requires contextual decision trees so analysts can assess automated recommendations.
rationale.org-governance: Proposes SOC-wide automation appraisal, training, and adoption controls.
rationale.lit-review: Model and CSFs derive explicitly from secondary literature and emergent themes.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes automation maximalism, advocating complementary human-centered adoption.
rationale.general-ai: Studies automated decision aids in SOCs, not AI-generated code.
rationale.risk-security: Analyzes security consequences of ignored alerts and weak human monitoring.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Over-reliance and complacency are focal harms with proposed mitigations.
